title: 'Purpose without power is just poetry' — Sylvie Reinhard on why she stopped handing governance over to the lawyers
summary: Swiss governance advocate Sylvie Reinhard — board member (SUISA, Republik Magazine, HEAD Geneva), formerly CEO of Lift Conference — pulls a line from Incorruptible that reframed her work: 'Purpose without power is just poetry.' She reflects on the shift from finding governance boring to seeing it as protecting what you care for.
blockquote: Purpose without power is just poetry
blockquote_source: Sylvie Reinhard on LinkedIn, quoting Incorruptible
